name: asiatic acid
summary: Triterpenoid aglycone associated with tissue repair and inflammatory pathway effects.
description: Asiatic acid is a triterpenoid aglycone associated with tissue repair and modulation of inflammatory pathways, relevant to wound-healing and stress-response biology.
safetyNotes: Human evidence mostly from Centella extracts/topicals. Caution with liver disease, sedatives, pregnancy, and high-dose oral extracts.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
